identity: Lethariel keeps the oldest trees in the Accord, and someone with a forged bough-seal is counting them for the axe.

quests.title: Meat for the Table
quests.text: The Star Hall wants a meal worthy of its deliberations, preferably ready before anyone finishes deliberating. Bring me eight Raw Meat; the game in the {name:glades} can supply it by day. I can manage the seasoning once they settle on a time.

variants.text: The Star Hall wants a meal worthy of its deliberations, preferably ready before anyone finishes deliberating. Bring me eight Raw Meat; the game in the {name:glades} can supply it by day. I can manage the seasoning once they settle on a time.

Hungry fighters line up when I raise the ladle, which saves a great deal of shouting. Bring me eight Raw Meat for the pot; there is game on the {name:steppe} by day. I would like to keep my authority well fed.

Half of Kezamba has followed its nose to the smokehouse, and the other half will hear about it shortly. Bring me eight Raw Meat; the game in the {name:canopy} can supply it by day. A good smell makes promises too.

I have set places for mourners who may have forgotten there is a kitchen. Bring me eight Raw Meat for their meal; there is game in the {name:blightfields} by day. They need not find something to say before they sit down.

quests.lesson: A daytime errand on the capital's outskirts.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS. Draft §4 and the check's fix: the cooks' simple Raw Meat deliveries as one shared task (Highcourt's cook asks for a Gnarled Boar Tusk, Varda's Mire Carp is BANDQUESTS' fish quest); each capital's day game as the named source.

quests.title: What the Seal Was For
quests.text: Poacher Bough-Counter Rusk uses the bough-seal to mark old trees for cutting that was never granted. Kill him at the {name:poacher_camp}, {dir_from_giver:poacher_camp}, and report to me. He knows how permission is recorded, and he is counting on others to read only the seal.
quests.completion: Rusk will mark no more trees for his own trade. I will keep his false records with the case; the handwriting may be useful if it appears on another claim.
quests.lesson: The capital's named leader at his camp, alone: the capital's local finale.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: a new id (its objectives changed); free play, a level only.

quests.title: A Forester's Path
quests.text: The foresters know which roots trip the unwary; it is the teeth between the roots that worry them. Hunt six Silver-Tip Vixens by day in the {name:greatwood}. The tenders have work enough without being driven off their paths.
quests.lesson: A day hunt in the greatwood.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the id stays (objectives unchanged); free play, a level only.

quests.title: The Missing Half of the Pie
quests.text: Ilwen Petalmeasure's berry deliveries keep shrinking, though the pies I am asked to make remain the same size. Speak to her at Lorindor Berrycourt about what the tolls are costing the harvest. I would like to know who is eating the missing half before it reaches my kitchen.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: Bread Does Not Keep Star-Time
quests.text: Lethen Moonledger keeps missing his bread collections, and bread is less patient than the sky. Go to Moonfall Observatory and ask what is keeping him. If his mind is occupied by something serious, there may be more useful work there than reminding him to eat.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).

quests.title: Where the Writ Wears Thin
quests.text: Faeris Rootbinder at Glassroot Gate needs help in Glassroot Wilds, where keeping a promise is harder than issuing it from Lethariel. Go and speak to her about the work. Our protection ought to reach the people tending those places, not stop at the edge of a document.
quests.notes: Round 60 CAPITALS: the handover id stays; free play, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §10).
